Ideal fully occupied CsCl-type B2 FeSi, identified in Fischer (2014), Sections 3.2 and 4.2/Figure 5; Pm-3m (No. 221), Fe 1a and Si 1b. Reference a is the measured Table S2 row 70 lattice at 42.7476826557 GPa and 1176.245 K. This compressed diffraction reference is separate from the extrapolated EOS V0. Only explicitly labelled Peritheos refits are executable. The published Fischer B2 coefficients remain in the source audit because their thermal normalization is unresolved.

<details markdown="1">
<summary>Parameter provenance</summary>

- **Origin of the parameterization:** Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: Table 2/S6 fixed assumptions; Official Table S2, all 114 phase=B2 observations; scripts/refit\_fischer\_2014\_b2.py and docs/data/fischer-2014-b2-refits.json.
- **Equation:** Standard BM3 or Vinet plus reference-subtracted Debye thermal pressure, gamma=gamma0\*(V/V0)^q and integrated-Gruneisen theta law; physical n=2 per FeSi formula.
- **V0:** Fischer (2014) Table 2: adopted 6.414 cm3/mol atoms, held fixed; converted with 2/.602214076 to angstrom^3/B2 cell.
- **K0 prime:** Fischer (2014) Table 2/S6: adopted 4.17, held fixed as a conditional fit assumption.
- **Theta0:** Fischer (2014) Table 2/S6: 417 K adopted from iron, held fixed.
- **K0:** Independent fit in scripts/refit\_fischer\_2014\_b2.py
- **Gamma0:** Independent fit with physical thermal normalization; no claim this is an authoritative correction to the published gamma0.
- **Q:** Independent fit; strongly correlated with K0 and gamma0.
- **Uncertainties:** Conditional local 1-sigma errors: covariance=(J.T J)^-1\*SSE/(114-3). Observations are treated as independent with equal residual variance. These errors omit fixed-input uncertainty, run correlations, calibrant systematics and model discrepancy. Sensitivity cases are not a probability distribution.

</details>

## Observation datasets

### fischer\_2014\_table\_s2\_pvt

- **Description:** All 180 source observations, including excluded phases and pressure-marker observations; derived cell volumes supplement unchanged numeric source inputs.
- **Kind:** pressure\_volume\_temperature\_multiphase\_with\_calibrant
- **Reference:**
    - **Authors:** Fischer; Campbell; Caracas; Reaman; Heinz; Dera; Prakapenka
    - **Year:** 2014
    - **Title:** Equations of state in the Fe–FeSi system at high pressures and temperatures
    - **Source:** Journal of Geophysical Research: Solid Earth
    - **Volume:** 119
    - **Locator:** 2810-2827
    - **DOI:** 10.1002/2013JB010898
- **Source location:** 2014 official Table S2, source worksheet row numbers retained
- **Associated EOS records:** fesi\_b2\_fischer\_2014\_bm3\_refit; fesi\_b2\_fischer\_2014\_vinet\_refit
- **Notes:** Original numerical precision is retained. Source zero uncertainties remain zero, blank uncertainties remain blank. No open data license was identified. The CSV contains factual measurements, not the source table image or layout. Sample temperatures already include the source gradient correction and must not be corrected again. Asterisks are recorded in source\_flags and their numeric fields left blank: \* means one d-spacing, uncertainty undefined; \*\* in Table S2 means phase detected but no reliable lattice parameter. The exceptional S2 row 62 marks both phase columns \*\*, which is preserved without repair. Derived cubic volumes are a^3; hcp volumes are sqrt(3)/2\*a^3\*(c/a). Covariance of a and c/a is not given, so no independent-error volume sigma is fabricated. The complete S2 data also support the withheld B2 audit. KBr lattice uncertainties are standard errors across indexed d-spacings; pressure errors propagate marker lattice and temperature uncertainty. The 2012 source also identifies sample lattice errors as standard errors. The 2014 temperature errors combine 100 K analytical uncertainty, differences between the two sample sides and thickness correction; no confidence level is specified. The B2 records are independent refits using all 114 phase=B2 rows; source-published B2 parameters remain non-executable.

[Observation resource](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/peritheos/data/datasets/fischer-2014-table-s2-pvt.csv)
